festival_crowds: Festival Surges: Extremely dense and packed, with single-day footfalls scaling to over 2 lakh people during Bonalu weekend. Security barricades are erected, and major nearby thoroughfares like RP Road are completely closed to general vehicle traffic.
tips: Normal Weekdays: Highly peaceful and comfortable. Wait time 10 to 15 minutes.
Tuesdays, Fridays, & Sundays: Heavy Crowd Surges. Fridays are exceptionally busy due to special evening prayers, causing lines to stretch significantly.
